summary: optionalDependencies resolves an unpinned GitHub repository at install time
details: package.json declares an optional dependency `fca-unofficial` whose source is the bare GitHub slug `github:VangBanLaNhat/fca-unofficial`, with no commit SHA or tag. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever currently sits at that repository's default branch and runs any lifecycle scripts present in the fetched tree, so the content executed on the installer is controlled by the current owner of that external repository rather than by the published tarball. The dependency is also referenced by the shipped E2EE engine, raising the likelihood that resolution succeeds and the fetched tree is loaded in normal use. Separately, the package ships ~15-17MB prebuilt x86-64 native binaries (messagix.so/messagix.dll) under src/api/socket/e2ee/native/build/ that are loaded via koffi FFI when the environment variable FCA_E2EE_NATIVE=1 is set; the binaries are opaque and attributed in NOTICE.md to mautrix-go/mautrix-meta but cannot be verified from source. The remaining base64/`ping` matches are inside the E2EE ratchet/store code paths and a vendored library, consistent with cryptographic encoding and keepalive logic.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
